title: No Escape from the Quadratic Barrier: Adaptive Attacks on Linear $\ell_2$ Sketches
abstract: arXiv:2610.25008v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Linear sketches estimate properties of high-dimensional inputs from a fixed low-dimensional projection. At constant accuracy, randomized Euclidean-norm sketches, notably the Johnson-Lindenstrauss transform, support exponentially many nonadaptive queries in sketch dimension $k$. For adaptive black-box queries, known privacy-based defenses guarantee $\widetilde{\Omega}(k^2)$ and it remained open whether stronger guarantees were possible. Prior attacks used more queries, restricted the responder, or provided weaker failure guarantees. translated_title: 无法逃离的二次方屏障：针对线性 $\ell_2$ 草图的自适应攻击
translated_abstract: 线性草图通过固定的低维投影来估计高维输入的性质。在恒定精度下，随机化的欧几里得范数草图（尤其是 Johnson-Lindenstrauss 变换）可以在草图维度 $k$ 下支持指数级数量的非自适应查询。对于自适应黑盒查询，已知的基于隐私的防御可提供 $\widetilde{\Omega}(k^2)$ 的保证，而能否获得更强的保证一直是悬而未决的问题。先前的攻击要么需要更多查询，要么限制了响应者，要么只能提供较弱的失败保证。我们证明，二次方保证在对数因子意义下是最优的——即使响应者拥有无限制的计算能力，知晓矩阵、攻击算法、历史记录和查询分布，并且可以在每次查询后更改其随机化规则。对于每个固定的隐藏矩阵 $A\in\mathbb{R}^{k\times n}$（其中 $n>40k$）以及目标精度 $\alpha \in (0,1]$，我们的黑盒攻击使用 $O(k+\alpha^2k^2\log(\cdots))$ 次查询（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文证明，即使响应者计算能力无限制且掌握全部信息，针对线性 $\ell_2$ 草图的自适应黑盒攻击也只需约 $O(k+\alpha^2k^2)$ 量级的查询即可破坏其精度，因此约 $k^2$ 的二次方防御保证在对数因子范围内已是最优、无法逃脱。
en_tdlr: The quadratic (~k²) privacy guarantee of linear ℓ₂ sketches against adaptive black-box queries is optimal up to logarithmic factors, as a black-box attack with O(k + α²k²)-scale queries defeats even a computationally unbounded, fully informed responder.
